MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 34
   C. 17
   D. 66

3. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 5
   C. 4
   D. 8

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

5. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 21
   C. 42
   D. 30

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

8. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19

9. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

10. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

13. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

14. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

16. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 8
   C. 24.5
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
